summary: Iteration_17 re-verification of the tyre-form cold-URL redirect race fix. RESULT: PASS on ALL scenarios. (1) FIX-1 (Add Tyre cold URL) — Hard refresh via page.goto('/inventory/tyre-form') for the signed-in Owner (qa.owner+1785851063@tyrebook.test) NO LONGER redirects. Waited 8 seconds, URL remained /inventory/tyre-form and the Add Tyre form rendered (tyre-brand testID visible). Filled the form (Brand=CEAT, Model=Fuelsmarrt, Size=195/65 R15, Category=Car, Class=New, Purchase 3200, Sell 4100, Stock 6, Min Alert 2) → Save Tyre succeeded, tyre now visible in Car inventory ('CEAT · Fuelsmarrt 195/65 R15 · Buy ₹3,200 · Sell ₹4,100 · Qty 6'). Inventory chip count went from 11 → 17 New Tyres, Car went from 4 → 10 in stock (+6). (2) Additional cold-URL sanity: /purchase/new and /smart-purchase also NO LONGER bounce to /(tabs)/dashboard for the Owner. Both rendered their full form/scanner within 1s and URL held for 6s. (3) REGRESSION (Cash sale) — Filled sale for 'Sanity Cash QA' (mobile 9990003333) x1 CEAT Fuelsmarrt @ ₹4,100 with GST 18% Cash. Save Sale succeeded (~7s to redirect due to Firestore batch write + PDF-share side effect), redirect to /(tabs)/billing occurred, new bill TB-0015 · Sanity Cash QA · CEAT Fuelsmarrt · 195/65 R15 · Qty 1 · Cash · ₹4,838 visible at top of billing list, CEAT Fuelsmarrt stock decremented 6 → 5. The AuthContext.authFired flag + `loading = !authFired` binding in usePermissions correctly gates the redirect until Firebase's onAuthStateChanged has actually fired (or the 4000ms failsafe). No regressions observed.

ui_bugs.issue: When the Add Tyre form is opened via a cold URL (deep link / hard refresh) with no prior navigation history, tapping Save Tyre triggers a react-navigation console error: `The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled by any navigator. Is there any screen to go back to?`. The tyre IS saved successfully (verified — CEAT Fuelsmarrt is now in Car inventory with stock 6), and the toast shows, but the user is left staring at the same form. In practice user must tap the back arrow manually. Suggest replacing router.back() with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/inventory')` after a successful save. Reference: /app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx (save handler, near the router.back() call after Alert.OK).

action_items: MAIN AGENT (E1) — LOW / OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx (also worth checking /purchase/new.tsx and /smart-purchase/index.tsx), after a successful save the code calls `router.back()`. On a cold-URL deep-link there is no back stack, so react-navigation logs a 'GO_BACK not handled' error and the user stays on the form. Replace with a canGoBack() guard: `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/inventory')`. Not blocking iteration_17; tyre WAS saved.
MAIN AGENT (E1) — NONE required for FIX-1. The cold-URL redirect race is fully resolved by the authFired + `loading = !authFired` pattern. Nothing further to do.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:26-48 — Correctly implements the authFired pattern. `setAuthFired(true)` is called ONLY inside the subscribeAuth callback (line 33) and inside the manual signIn/signUp/signOut mutators (lines 58/63/68). The failsafe (line 40-42) now only flips `initializing` (splash-screen dismiss) and does NOT flip `authFired`, so permission gates in usePermissions correctly wait for the real auth event. Failsafe raised from 1500ms → 4000ms which comfortably covers Firebase IndexedDB rehydration in the web-preview environment.

/app/frontend/src/hooks/usePermissions.ts:31-41 — `loading: !authFired` is the correct semantics. Now Add-Tyre / Purchase / Smart-Purchase / Admin routes gate on the first-auth-event, not on the failsafe. Cold-URL redirects no longer misfire.

/app/frontend/app/inventory/tyre-form.tsx — Save flow works but post-save `router.back()` fails on cold URL because navigation stack is empty. Non-blocking (tyre is written to Firestore), but leads to a small UX papercut. See ui_bugs above.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_17 fully closes the tyre-form cold-URL race. The `authFired` flag pattern in AuthContext + `loading = !authFired` in usePermissions is the correct fix. If any future iteration reopens this: reproduce by logging in via UI, then `page.goto('http://localhost:3000/inventory/tyre-form')` in a fresh tab-context (fresh Playwright browser context) and asserting the URL stays after 5s. The only minor loose end is `router.back()` on cold-URL save — belongs to E1's next polish pass (see action_items).
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration_17 is a re-verification of a previously-diagnosed bug. Fix confirmed working. The RCA from iteration_16 (Firebase IndexedDB rehydration racing the 1500ms failsafe) is addressed by decoupling the splash-dismiss trigger (initializing) from the permission-gate trigger (authFired), so the failsafe can safely un-hang the splash without misfiring the redirect guards.
